cases.translation: Fill these men's sacks with food.
cases.explain: The transitive verb наполнить takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.translation: Fill these men's sacks with food.
cases.explain: The verb наполнить takes the filling material in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Ведь это чаши моего ___, из которой он пьёт.
cases.translation: For this is the cup of my lord, from which he drinks.
cases.explain: Possession (the cup of my lord) is expressed with the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Позволь твоему ___ сказать моему господину слово.
cases.translation: Let your servant speak a word to my lord.
cases.explain: The verb позволить takes the person permitted in the dative case.

cases.translation: The cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Why have you repaid evil for good?
cases.explain: The means of payment with заплатить stands in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Не гневайся на твоего раба, хотя ты равен самому ___.
cases.translation: Do not be angry at your servant, though you are equal to Pharaoh himself.
cases.explain: The adjective равен (equal to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: They threw themselves down before him to the ground.
cases.explain: The preposition на expressing motion onto a surface takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: Чаша нашлась в мешке у Вениамина.
reading.question: In whose sack was the cup found?
reading.explain: The text says 'Чаша нашлась в мешке у Вениамина' (the cup was found in Benjamin's sack).

reading.ru: Они разорвали на себе одежду, нагрузили каждый своего осла и вернулись в город.
reading.question: What did the brothers do when the cup was discovered?
options: They tore their clothes and returned to the city
reading.correct: They tore their clothes and returned to the city
reading.explain: The text says they tore their clothes, loaded their donkeys, and returned to the city.

reading.ru: Как только рассвело, братьев отправили в путь вместе с их ослами.
reading.question: When were the brothers sent on their way?
options: As soon as it was light
reading.correct: As soon as it was light
reading.explain: The text says 'Как только рассвело' (as soon as it dawned) they were sent off.

reading.ru: Иуда и его братья вернулись в дом Иосифа, который все еще был там, они бросились перед ним на землю.
reading.question: What did Judah and his brothers do at Joseph's house?
options: They fell to the ground before him
reading.correct: They fell to the ground before him
reading.explain: The text says they returned to Joseph's house and threw themselves to the ground before him.

reading.ru: Управляющий начал искать, начиная со старшего, кончая младшим.
reading.question: How did the steward search the sacks?
options: From the oldest to the youngest
From the youngest to the oldest
reading.correct: From the oldest to the youngest
reading.explain: The text says the steward searched beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest.

reading.ru: Итак, молю тебя, позволь твоему рабу остаться здесь, рабом моего господина, вместо мальчика, и позволь мальчику вернуться с братьями
reading.question: What did Judah offer to do?
options: To stay as a slave in place of the boy
To pay a ransom in gold
reading.correct: To stay as a slave in place of the boy
reading.explain: Judah begs to remain as a slave instead of the boy, letting the boy return with his brothers.
